fields.Name: T59 - Entity Form Edit Event
fields.Description: Edits a safe text field on an Event record and saves, verifying the change persists.

InputDefinition.goal: Open an Event's full record form. Modify ONLY the 'Location' text field (or 'Description') to a new value such as 'Updated Test Location'. Do NOT modify numeric fields like CEU Credits, Capacity, or price fields (they have value-range constraints). Click Save and verify the change persists. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The full event form is open and an editable field such as Location or Capacity was changed to a new value
A save was performed and a save confirmation or the persisted new value is visible
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
